# CODEX (23 · codex)

A library of illuminated manuscripts — animated gold leaf, generative borders, marginalia by bored monks.

- **Technique:** ILLUMINATED SVG
- **Tags:** medieval, books, library, heritage, illuminated, scholarly, classic, ornate
- **Best for:** libraries & bookshops; museums; heritage orgs; publishers
- **Fonts:** EB Garamond, Cardo, Caveat
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400&family=Cardo:ital@0;1&family=Caveat:wght@500&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #f0e6d0 · #2b3a6b · #c9a13b
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/codex/` (Template.astro, border.ts, content.ts, meta.ts, panels.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Signature effects
- `border.ts`
  - `initBorder(svg: SVGSVGElement)` — Illuminated border: double rule, corner ornaments, and a vine with leaves and gold berries down both sides.
- `panels.ts`
  - `initPanels(els: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Draw each `[data-panel]` element's illustration. `data-panel` picks the artwork; `data-caption` and `data-label` supply the Latin inscriptions.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<span>/<br>/<a> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Illustration drawn into a manuscript panel by panels.ts. */
export type PanelKind = 'beast' | 'hours' | 'map';

export interface Manuscript {
  panel: PanelKind;
  title: string;
  /** Italic line under the title, e.g. "c. 1211 · Canterbury". */
  date: string;
  text: string;
  /** Latin caption written inside the illustration. */
  caption: string;
  /** Extra inscription inside the illustration (used by `hours` and `map`). */
  label?: string;
}

export interface Step {
  /** Roman numeral, e.g. "i.". */
  no: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
}

/** A handwritten note in the folio's margin. Offsets are CSS lengths. */
export interface Marginalia {
  textHtml: string;
  /** Which side of the folio it hangs off. */
  side: 'left' | 'right';
  /** Distance outside that side, e.g. "-170px". */
  offset: string;
  /** Vertical position: set exactly one of `top` / `bottom`, e.g. "30%". */
  top?: string;
  bottom?: string;
  /** Tilt in degrees. Default -4. */
  rotate?: number;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark in nav + footer, e.g. `CODE<b>X</b>`. */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** Red italic line above the title. */
    rubric: string;
    /** Title; the gold animated drop-cap is `<span class="init">C</span>`. */
    headingHtml: string;
    subHtml: string;
    /** Small italic line under the intro. */
    folioFoot: string;
    marginalia: Marginalia[];
  };
  collection: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    manuscripts: Manuscript[];
  };
  scriptorium: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    steps: Step[];
  };
  visit: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    bodyHtml: string;
    /** Letter pressed into the wax seal. */
    seal: string;
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
  /** Showcase-only chrome; rendered when the template's `showcase` prop is true. */
  showcase?: {
    chipLabel: string;
    chipHref: string;
    footerHtml: string;
  };
}
```
